company.name: Adialante
company.shortDescription: Adialante develops low-cost, clinical-grade MRI systems and related services for accessible cancer and neuroimaging screening.
company.description: Adialante develops deployable, clinical-grade MRI systems designed to reduce the cost and footprint of traditional scanners. The company focuses on a novel B1 encoding architecture that minimizes or removes B0 gradient coils to enable quieter, portable neuroimaging. Its platform targets cancer and brain screening in clinics and communities that lack conventional MRI infrastructure. Adialante also offers workshops, innovation courses, and consultation services related to clinical partnerships and healthcare technology development. Customers include healthcare providers, clinics, and research organizations seeking accessible MRI solutions.
